verdict.rationale: pnpm is a locally run, self-contained package-manager CLI. It does not hold user data in a hosted account, so "export all of my data and leave" is a category error for this kind of product, not a capability it fails to deliver. The evidence describes local project files (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, lockfiles) and npm drop-in compatibility, not any vendor-held data to export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
